brep_observables: two semicircular caps and two straight segments
preconditions: strict containment and positive width/straight length

parameter_contract: Only the six frozen record-specific base, centre, width, straight-length, and declared-axis parameters are evidenced.
expected_brep_delta: A rectangular base receives one through subtraction whose composite profile retains two semicircular caps, two straight segments, and the declared cap-to-cap axis.
topology_invariants: One connected solid remains; the cut is through; base extents remain; and the cap-to-cap direction agrees with the declared +X or +Y frame.
numeric_or_tolerance_boundary: No arbitrary-angle domain, frame-recovery algorithm, or numeric tolerance is claimed beyond frozen records and existing geometry-gate tolerance.
unverified_properties: Arbitrary orientation, generic local-frame recovery, rotated bases, curved profiles beyond the fixed caps, alternate sequences, and generic CAD-kernel API behavior.

CutPocket targets the base and consumes that profile.
